title: Artefacts: Artifactory, Nexus and image registries

videos.script: Git says which image to run. The registry holds it. If either one lies, the cluster runs something nobody decided. {{both}} This lesson opens an image and finds what is really there. An index, manifests, layers, and a digest that covers every byte. {{inside}} Then you move a tag on purpose, and watch the same name start meaning different code. That is why production gets pinned by digest. {{digest}} Charts become artefacts too, published once and pulled by version. You will meet the repository managers most companies run, Artifactory and Nexus, and what their proxies change. {{managers}} Then Flux starts proposing new releases by itself. Not by pushing to main, but by opening a branch that goes through review like everything else. {{auto}} Last, what to keep and what to delete, when every old commit might be a rollback. {{keep}}
